title: Cozy Home Central to Everything
description:
Stay in a quiet, safe neighborhood just minutes from downtown Nashville! This comfortable 1-bedroom apartment is across from the Richland Greenway, offering a peaceful walk/bike ride to Centennial Park and the iconic Parthenon. Vanderbilt and West End are nearby, with lower Broadway just a 5-minute drive. Enjoy a private driveway, private outdoor area, full kitchen, WiFi, washer/dryer access, and easy access to the airport (20 min) & interstates. Perfect for a relaxing stay in Nashville!

The space
This charming 1-bedroom apartment offers comfort and convenience in a prime location. Featuring beautiful hardwood floors, a queen bed with a TV in the bedroom, a full kitchen stocked with essentials for cooking, and a private outdoor area, it’s perfect for a relaxing stay. Enjoy the ease of a private washer and dryer, plus off-street parking in your own driveway. Just minutes from downtown, this space is ideal for couples or solo travelers looking for a home away from home!

Guest access
The entire space is yours to use. You will have electronic key access.
